title: Kutongwa kweMurazvo Mutsvene
intro: Munyika yekare umo kuzvipira kumatombo akavezwa kwakanga kwadzika midzi mudzimba dzese, munhu mumwe chete akamira akasiyana. Nekutenda kusingazununguki uye dziviriro yaMwari, vakatarisana nerufu rwaifanira kunge rwaiva rwechokwadi - ndokuenda vasina kukuvara. Unogona kuburitsa pachena hunhu hwemweya uyu unoshamisa here?
clues: Ndakakurira pakati pevanhu vaipfugamira zvifananidzo zvavaive vagadzira nemaoko avo, vachitenda kuti zvinhu izvi zvine simba raMwari.
Pandakapikisa zvavaitenda, pakutanga vakandiramba, asi handina kukwanisa kuramba ndakanyarara nezvechokwadi chandaiziva.
Pazuva ravakaungana, ndakaparadza zvidhori zvavo, ndikasiya chikuru chete chisina kubatwa.
Pavakadzoka vakaona zvandakanga ndaita, vatungamiriri vavo vakarayira kuti pavakwe murwi mukuru, vachida kundikanda mumoto.
Vakandikanda mumoto unopfuta, asi Ishe wenyika vakarayira kuti utonhore uye ugare wakachengeteka kwandiri.
Ndakabuda mumoto ndisina kukuvara zvachose, asi avo vaironga kundirwisa vakasangana nekuparadzwa kukuru.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro

outcome.answer: Mwari vakaita kuti moto utonhore uye ugare wakachengeteka

arabic: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verse: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act." (21:68)
